content.value_statement: Trading competition workflows require status checks, wallet context, and fixed response templates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through OKX competition discovery, registration, ranking, reward claims, and contact follow-up.
actual_capabilities: Lists active and ended OKX Agentic Wallet trading competitions with chain, time, prize pool, and detail links.
Explains competition rules, prize pools, ranking categories, and supported trading chains from detail data.
Guides wallet registration and duplicate-registration handling for OKX competitions.
Checks leaderboard positions, personal ranks, participation status, and reward status.
Handles reward claim previews, confirmation flow, transaction result reporting, and winner contact submission.
Delegates supported trade requests to the OKX Agentic Wallet swap flow after confirmation.
limitations: Requires an OKX Agentic Wallet session and the onchainos or MCP tools for private actions.
Does not decide whether a trade is suitable or reduce digital asset trading risk.
Can only report data returned by OKX competition APIs and configured leaderboards.
Reward claims and swaps can have irreversible on-chain effects after confirmation.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitions
use_cases.description: Review active and ended competitions before choosing where to participate.

use_cases.title: Track Ranking and Rewards
use_cases.description: Check leaderboard positions, prize-zone status, and reward eligibility across every leaderboard.

use_cases.title: Resolve Registration Status
use_cases.description: Explain duplicate registration, registered wallet, region limits, and claim status errors.

prompt_templates.title: List Competitions
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me all OKX Agentic Wallet trading competitions and separate active ones from ended ones.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the rules, supported chains, timeline, and prize pool for [competition name].

prompt_templates.title: Check My Standing
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my rank and reward status for [competition name] across every leaderboard.

prompt_templates.title: Claim With Contact Follow-up
prompt_templates.prompt: For [competition name], check my reward status. If I can claim, preview the amount and chain, wait for my confirmation, then guide any required winner contact submission.

output_examples.output: The skill returns active and ended competition tables with name, supported chains, time, prize pool, and OKX detail links.

output_examples.input: Did I win Agentic Trading Contest?
output_examples.output: The skill reports join status, reward status, reward amount when available, and whether a claim is currently possible.

output_examples.input: Claim my reward for Agentic Trading Contest.
output_examples.output: The skill previews the reward amount and chain, asks for explicit confirmation, then reports the claim result and transaction hash.

best_practices: Review competition detail data before registration so chain and prize rules are clear.
Confirm every claim, swap, or contact submission with the user before calling a tool.
Use activity names in user messages and keep internal IDs out of final replies.
anti_patterns: Do not claim rewards, execute swaps, or submit contacts without explicit user confirmation.
Do not treat the claim chain and trading-chain set as the same field.
Do not expose activityId, chainIndex, or accountId in user-visible output.

faq.question: Can this skill register me for a competition?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide registration when your OKX Agentic Wallet session is active and the required tools are available.

faq.question: Can this skill trade for me?
faq.answer: It can delegate supported swap requests after confirmation. It does not provide financial advice.

faq.question: Can this skill claim rewards?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks reward status first, previews the reward amount and chain, and waits for explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Does it need my contact information?
faq.answer: Only some top-tier winners are asked for contact details after a successful claim. Sharing is optional.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes competition workflows and tool calls, but users remain responsible for trading decisions.
